description: This file defines a REST controller named DomainControllers for a Spring Boot application. It handles various API endpoints related to project management, including projects, contractors, tenders, contracts, milestones, inspections, handovers, funds, payments, and notifications. The class interacts with a service layer to perform CRUD operations and other business logic for each domain entity.

classes.name: DomainControllers
classes.description: REST controller for managing domain entities related to projects, contractors, tenders, contracts, milestones, inspections, handovers, funds, payments, and notifications.

methods.name: createProject
methods.description: Creates a new project based on provided DTO.

methods.name: listProjects
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of projects.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Retrieves a specific project by ID.

methods.name: updateProject
methods.description: Performs a partial update on a project.

methods.name: deleteProject
methods.description: Deletes a project identified by ID.

methods.name: createContractor
methods.description: Creates a new contractor.

methods.name: listContractors
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of contractors.

methods.name: updateContractor
methods.description: Updates details of an existing contractor.

methods.name: createTender
methods.description: Creates a new tender for a project.

methods.name: listTenders
methods.description: Lists tenders for a specific project.

methods.name: updateTender
methods.description: Updates information of a specific tender.

methods.name: createContract
methods.description: Creates a new contract.

methods.name: listContracts
methods.description: Lists contracts associated with a project.

methods.name: updateContract
methods.description: Updates contract details.

methods.name: createMilestone
methods.description: Creates a project milestone.

methods.name: listMilestones
methods.description: Lists milestones for a project.

methods.name: updateMilestone
methods.description: Updates milestone details.

methods.name: createInspection
methods.description: Records a new inspection.

methods.name: recordHandover
methods.description: Records a project handover; marks completion.

methods.name: createFund
methods.description: Creates a fund entry for a project.

methods.name: createPayment
methods.description: Creates a new payment to a contractor.

methods.name: updatePaymentStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a payment.

methods.name: getNotifications
methods.description: Retrieves notifications for a specified user.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification to a user.
